# Arnab Mandal

> AI Engineer & GenAI Specialist (Enterprise AI Platform Intern at Fidelity International, Gurgaon). Specializes in GenAI applications, systems-level engineering, LLM inference optimization, and RAG architectures. Portfolio at https://arnab-mandal-portfolio.vercel.app.

Arnab builds logic-powered products that work — from Graph-RAG Text-to-SQL agents and speculative decoding for vLLM to PII redaction and document guardrails at scale. Tagline: "I like finetuning stuff."

## Featured Projects

- [Domino Speculative Decoding for vLLM](https://github.com/Eros483/speculators): Inference + distributed training support for Domino in vLLM; 18% throughput gain on Qwen3, 27% acceptance length over DFlash across 7 benchmarks (GSM8K, HumanEval, etc.)
- [AutoLinks: Distributed Semantic Internal Linking Engine](https://github.com/Eros483/AutoLinks): Async Go workers with Redis queue + DLQ, Qdrant vector search, GLiNER entity extraction; 85%+ LLM-as-a-judge acceptance, p95 600ms — live at https://autolinks.vercel.app
- [AuthChain](https://github.com/Eros483/AuthChain): Cryptographic governance & consensus for autonomous agents; interruption-driven control with blockchain-audited execution — live at https://auth-chain-five.vercel.app
- [Graph-RAG Text-to-SQL Agent](https://github.com/Eros483/SQL-generation-engine): Natural language to SQL for healthcare warehouse (43 tables, 62 relationships, 1GB); AWS Bedrock + LangGraph; +33% multi-join accuracy, validated for production
- [Llava Inference via TensorRT and Triton](https://github.com/Eros483/Llava_Inference_TensorRT_Triton): Custom docs and forked Triton/TensorRT for efficient multimodal VLM inference
- [Krishi AI Sahayak](https://github.com/Eros483/SIH25-Farmers): Unified API + Android app for farmers — live at https://sih25-farmers.onrender.com/docs
- [RAG-Toolkit](https://github.com/Eros483/RagToolkitServer): Modular GPU-accelerated RAG system with FastAPI + Streamlit, llama-cpp-python
- [GPT-2 Style LLM from Scratch](https://github.com/Eros483/GPT-2_LLM_Architecture): Tokenization, multi-head attention, positional encodings in PyTorch/NumPy — and 20 more in the archive
